assertions.subject: Hemangiopericytoma
assertions.quote: Hemangiopericytoma, arising from the pericytes of Zimmerman, is one of the most commonly reported primary tumors of the omentum.

assertions.subject: Solitary Fibrous Tumor/Hemangiopericytoma
assertions.quote: Cases of omental rhabdomyosarcoma, small cell carcinoma, malignant solitary fibrous tumor, malignant fibrous histiocytoma, lipomas, yolk sac tumor, and angiofibrolipoma have been reported.

assertions.subject: Primary omental mesothelioma
assertions.quote: Primary omental mesothelioma is related to asbestos exposure.

assertions.subject: Liposarcoma
assertions.quote: Liposarcoma and leiomyosarcoma are the most common intraabdominal soft tissue sarcoma but rarely occur within the omentum as a primary tumor.

assertions.subject: Desmoplastic round cell tumor of the omentum
assertions.quote: Desmoplastic round cell tumor of the omentum, a mesenchymal tumor, results from a chromosomal translocation that fuses the Ewing sarcoma and Wilm tumor suppressor genes, rendering an Ewing sarcoma RNA-binding protein-1.
